the radiant warmer is a thermoregulation system designed to provide a controlled thermal environment for newborns and infants. its primary purpose is to stabilize and maintain the patient s core body temperature at approximately 37 c through a microprocessor-controlled infrared heating element. the system is intended for use in delivery rooms, neonatal intensive care units (nicus), and pediatric wards to facilitate routine care, resuscitation, and minor surgical procedures while preventing neonatal cold stress. it shall support both servo (skin-temperature-led) and manual (user-defined output) modes to ensure clinical flexibility in both stable and emergency obstetric or neonatal scenarios.
